phase_title: PROCEED/HOLD/HALT 判定時の差し戻し・停止ルール設計
phase_purpose: Phase 17-2（Phase 15-7 実行可否判定）と Phase 17-3（Phase 15-8 実行可否判定）が出力する 3 種類の判定結果（PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_MEASUREMENT、HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION、HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_PHASE_15_7/PHASE_15_8）に対応するルール設計。各判定結果に応じて、次ステップ（測定実行、権限者判定待ち、差し戻し、停止）の条件、権限者判定フロー、差し戻し対象フェーズ、停止理由の記録、を定義する。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of decision handling rules only, no actual decision routing or authority decision processing yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 17-5 judgment handling rules are design-only; no actual authority decision routing, difference analysis, or return handling occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual decision routing or judgment result redistribution occurs.

judgment_decision_handling_framework.overview: Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 each output one of three possible results: PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT. Phase 17-5 defines the handling rules for each outcome and their combinations.

judgment_result_values.PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_MEASUREMENT: Phase 15-7 integrated_decision measurement workflow is cleared for execution; all 6 gates passed; judgment is final and signed
judgment_result_values.HOLD_PENDING_AUTHORITY_DECISION: One or more gates failed with non-blocking severity (readiness gap, caution flag); authority decision required before proceeding; measurement execution is suspended pending authority judgment
judgment_result_values.HALT_DO_NOT_EXECUTE_PHASE_15_7: One or more gates failed with blocking severity (receipt confirmation failure, state inconsistency); measurement execution is prohibited; Phase 16 diagnosis or Phase 17 gate re-evaluation required

scenario_1_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_P.scenario_name: Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows cleared for execution
scenario_1_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_P.handling_rule: Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 measurement workflows can proceed immediately. Execution order (sequential or concurrent) to be determined by authority; Phase 15-7 result may inform Phase 15-8 execution decision. Lock both judgment results immediately via Phase 17-4 procedures.
scenario_1_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_P.next_action: Authorize both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 execution
scenario_1_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_P.authority_involvement: Minimal; final authorization signature required on both locked judgment results

scenario_2_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.scenario_name: Phase 15-7 cleared for execution; Phase 15-8 pending authority decision
scenario_2_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.handling_rule: Phase 15-7 can proceed to execution immediately; Phase 15-8 is suspended. Authority must decide: (a) waive Phase 15-8 readiness gap and permit execution, (b) return Phase 17-3 to Phase 16-3 for readiness improvement, or (c) keep Phase 15-8 on hold until Phase 15-7 completes. Lock Phase 17-2 judgment immediately. Phase 17-3 handling depends on authority decision.
scenario_2_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.next_action: Phase 15-7 execution authorizes; escalate Phase 15-8 to authority decision committee
scenario_2_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.authority_involvement: Phase 15-8 readiness gap analysis + approval decision required; Phase 15-7 is final

scenario_3_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.scenario_name: Phase 15-7 cleared for execution; Phase 15-8 execution prohibited
scenario_3_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.handling_rule: Phase 15-7 can proceed immediately; Phase 15-8 is strictly prohibited until blocking gate(s) are resolved. Lock Phase 17-2 immediately. Perform forensic analysis on Phase 17-3 blocking gate failure; generate remediation plan. Authority must approve remediation before Phase 17-3 re-evaluation is permitted. Separate Phase 15-7 execution from Phase 15-8 remediation workflows.
scenario_3_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.next_action: Phase 15-7 proceeds; Phase 15-8 escalate blocking gate failure for remediation
scenario_3_phase17_2_PROCEED_phase17_3_H.authority_involvement: HALT decision is final; authority must approve Phase 15-8 re-evaluation strategy

scenario_4_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_PROC.scenario_name: Phase 15-7 pending authority decision; Phase 15-8 cleared for execution
scenario_4_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_PROC.handling_rule: Phase 15-8 can proceed to execution immediately; Phase 15-7 is suspended. Authority must decide for Phase 15-7: (a) waive readiness gap and permit execution, (b) return Phase 17-2 to Phase 16-3 for readiness improvement, or (c) keep on hold pending Phase 15-8 results. Lock Phase 17-3 judgment immediately. Phase 17-2 handling depends on authority decision.
scenario_4_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_PROC.next_action: Phase 15-8 execution authorizes; escalate Phase 15-7 to authority decision committee
scenario_4_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_PROC.authority_involvement: Phase 15-7 readiness gap analysis + approval decision required; Phase 15-8 is final

scenario_5_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HOLD.scenario_name: Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 pending authority decision
scenario_5_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HOLD.handling_rule: Both measurement workflows are suspended pending authority decision. Escalate both Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 readiness gap analyses to authority. Authority must decide for each workflow independently: (a) waive readiness gap, (b) return to Phase 16-3, or (c) hold pending additional data. Both judgment results remain unlocked until authority decision.
scenario_5_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HOLD.next_action: Escalate both readiness gaps to authority; await coordinated decision
scenario_5_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HOLD.authority_involvement: Authority must analyze both readiness gaps; may request re-evaluation, improvements, or conditional waivers

scenario_6_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HALT.scenario_name: Phase 15-7 pending authority decision; Phase 15-8 execution prohibited
scenario_6_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HALT.handling_rule: Phase 15-8 is strictly prohibited; Phase 15-7 is suspended. Perform forensic analysis on Phase 15-8 blocking gate failure immediately. For Phase 15-7, authority decides independently: waive, improve, or hold. Lock neither judgment result until Phase 15-8 remediation is approved and Phase 15-7 authority decision is finalized.
scenario_6_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HALT.next_action: Phase 15-8 blocking gate analysis + remediation plan; Phase 15-7 escalate to authority decision committee
scenario_6_phase17_2_HOLD_phase17_3_HALT.authority_involvement: Phase 15-8 HALT is final; authority must approve Phase 15-8 re-evaluation strategy. Phase 15-7 decision independent.

scenario_7_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_PROC.scenario_name: Phase 15-7 execution prohibited; Phase 15-8 cleared for execution
scenario_7_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_PROC.handling_rule: Phase 15-7 is strictly prohibited; Phase 15-8 can proceed immediately. Perform forensic analysis on Phase 15-7 blocking gate failure. Generate remediation plan for Phase 15-7. Lock Phase 17-3 immediately. Authority must approve Phase 15-7 remediation before re-evaluation is permitted.
scenario_7_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_PROC.next_action: Phase 15-8 proceeds; Phase 15-7 escalate blocking gate failure for remediation
scenario_7_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_PROC.authority_involvement: Phase 15-7 HALT is final; authority must approve Phase 15-7 re-evaluation strategy

scenario_8_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HALT.scenario_name: Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 execution prohibited
scenario_8_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HALT.handling_rule: Both measurement workflows are strictly prohibited. Perform forensic analysis on both Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 blocking gate failures. Generate comprehensive remediation plan addressing both workflows. Authority must review both failures and approve remediation strategies before any re-evaluation is permitted. Lock neither judgment result until remediation is approved.
scenario_8_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HALT.next_action: Forensic analysis on both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 blocking gates; escalate for authority decision on remediation
scenario_8_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HALT.authority_involvement: Authority must analyze both HALT decisions; may require Phase 16 re-evaluation or Phase 15-7/15-8 redesign; final approval required for re-entry

scenario_9_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HOLD.scenario_name: Phase 15-7 execution prohibited; Phase 15-8 pending authority decision
scenario_9_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HOLD.handling_rule: Phase 15-7 is strictly prohibited; Phase 15-8 is suspended. Perform forensic analysis on Phase 15-7 blocking gate failure immediately. For Phase 15-8, authority must decide independently: waive readiness gap, improve, or hold. Lock neither judgment result until Phase 15-7 remediation is approved and Phase 15-8 authority decision is finalized.
scenario_9_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HOLD.next_action: Phase 15-7 blocking gate forensic analysis + remediation plan; Phase 15-8 escalate readiness gap to authority
scenario_9_phase17_2_HALT_phase17_3_HOLD.authority_involvement: Phase 15-7 HALT is final; authority must approve Phase 15-7 re-evaluation strategy. Phase 15-8 decision independent.

judgment_result_return_and_difference_an.return_scenario_definition: A judgment result can be 'returned' when it fails pre-conditions or when upstream phase outputs (Phase 16, Phase 17-1, or Phase 17-2 for Phase 17-3) change, necessitating re-evaluation.
return_trigger_conditions: Phase 16 result changes or Phase 16-9 completion verification fails → return Phase 17-1 and downstream (Phase 17-2, 17-3)
Phase 17-1 receipt status downgrades or becomes inconsistent → return Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3
Phase 17-2 PROCEED result becomes invalid (underlying gate data changes) → return Phase 17-3 (as it may depend on Phase 15-7 execution authority)

difference_analysis_procedure.step_1_identify_change: Identify which upstream output changed (Phase 16 artifact, Phase 17-1 receipt status, or Phase 17-2 gate data)
difference_analysis_procedure.step_2_locate_affected_gates: Determine which Phase 17-2 or Phase 17-3 gates are affected by the change
difference_analysis_procedure.step_3_simulate_affected_gates: Re-evaluate affected gates with new data to determine outcome change (PASS → FAIL, or vice versa)
difference_analysis_procedure.step_4_compute_overall_impact: Determine how gate outcome changes affect overall feasibility result (PROCEED → HOLD, PROCEED → HALT, etc.)
difference_analysis_procedure.step_5_generate_difference_report: Document: original result, new result, gates affected, reason for change, recommendation (re-evaluation, remediation, return)
difference_analysis_procedure.step_6_escalate_return_request: Return judgment result to authority with difference report; request re-evaluation or confirm return necessity

return_routing_1_phase16_output_change.trigger: Phase 16 artifacts modified or Phase 16-9 completion verification fails
return_routing_1_phase16_output_change.return_target: Phase 17-1 (Phase 16 receipt validation must be re-performed)
return_routing_1_phase16_output_change.cascade_return: Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 must also be re-evaluated as downstream
return_routing_1_phase16_output_change.handling: Request Phase 17-1 re-execution; upon Phase 17-1 result, conditionally trigger Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 re-evaluation

return_routing_2_phase17_1_receipt_downg.trigger: Phase 17-1 receipt status changes from CONFIRMED to FAILED or consistency issues emerge
return_routing_2_phase17_1_receipt_downg.cascade_return: Both feasibility judgments become invalid as Phase 16 receipt condition is not met
return_routing_2_phase17_1_receipt_downg.handling: Mark Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 as requiring re-evaluation; automatically set gate_1 (Phase 16 receipt) to FAIL status

return_routing_3_phase17_2_gate_data_cha.trigger: Gate input data changes (e.g., Phase 16-3 feasibility status updated, authority decision overridden)
return_routing_3_phase17_2_gate_data_cha.cascade_return: If Phase 17-2 result changes from PROCEED to HOLD/HALT, Phase 17-3 may need re-evaluation depending on Phase 17-3's gate 6 (integrated_decision observation gate)
return_routing_3_phase17_2_gate_data_cha.handling: Perform gate re-evaluation (Difference Analysis Step 3); if overall result changes, escalate for authority review

halt_handling_framework.halt_decision_finality: HALT decision is final at the time it is issued; no automatic override or retry loop is permitted

halt_types.halt_type_blocking_gate_failure: One or more blocking gates (gates 1-5 in Phase 17-2 or Phase 17-3) failed with blocking severity
halt_types.halt_type_receipt_confirmation_failure: Phase 17-1 overall receipt status is FAILED; Phase 16 artifacts are inconsistent or incomplete
halt_types.halt_type_state_inconsistency: integrated_decision or receiver_validator_permission state is inconsistent with expected values

procedure_1_forensic_analysis.action: Perform detailed root cause analysis on why gate(s) failed
procedure_1_forensic_analysis.output: Forensic report: gate failure reason, contributing factors, data inconsistencies, evidence of state problems

procedure_2_remediation_planning.action: Develop remediation plan addressing root causes
plan_elements: Which Phase must be re-evaluated or modified (Phase 16, Phase 17-1, or Phase 17-2/17-3 gate conditions)
Specific action(s) required (fix Phase 16 artifact, re-validate Phase 17-1, update gate inputs, authority approval of new conditions)

procedure_3_authority_approval.action: Submit forensic report and remediation plan to authority for approval
authority_decision_options: APPROVE_REMEDIATION: Proceed with plan; upon completion, Phase 17-2 or Phase 17-3 can be re-evaluated
REQUEST_MODIFICATIONS: Modification to remediation plan required; resubmit for approval
ESCALATE_TO_DESIGN_PHASE: HALT is due to fundamental design flaw; Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8 measurement redesign required before proceeding
DEFER_INDEFINITELY: No remediation approved; Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8 measurement is indefinitely suspended

procedure_4_remediation_execution.action: Upon authority approval, execute remediation plan
procedure_4_remediation_execution.forbidden: Do not execute Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8 measurement workflows during remediation; measurement must wait for remediation completion

procedure_5_re_evaluation_authorization.action: Upon remediation completion, request re-evaluation of Phase 17-2 or Phase 17-3
procedure_5_re_evaluation_authorization.gate_re_evaluation_target: Re-evaluate only the previously failing gate(s); other gates retain their prior evaluation results

halt_record_elements.halt_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when HALT decision was issued
halt_record_elements.halt_reason: Narrative explanation of why HALT was necessary
halt_record_elements.blocking_gates: List of gate(s) that caused HALT (gate IDs and failure reasons)
halt_record_elements.remediation_plan: Detailed plan to resolve HALT condition
halt_record_elements.authority_decision: Authority's decision on remediation (APPROVE, REQUEST_MODIFICATIONS, ESCALATE, DEFER)

hold_handling_framework.hold_decision_non_finality: HOLD decision is suspensory, not final; authority must actively decide to proceed, improve, or escalate

hold_types.hold_type_readiness_gap: One or more gates have readiness gaps (caution flags, unmet soft pre-conditions) but are not blocking
hold_types.hold_type_insufficient_data: Additional data or verification needed before PROCEED or HALT determination is possible
hold_types.hold_type_authority_judgment_required: Gate evaluation resulted in CAUTION flag; human authority judgment needed to waive or enforce readiness requirement

procedure_1_readiness_gap_analysis.action: Document all readiness gaps identified in HOLD gates
procedure_1_readiness_gap_analysis.output: Readiness gap report: which gates have gaps, what conditions are unmet, severity of each gap, recommended improvements

procedure_2_authority_decision_request.action: Escalate readiness gap report to authority
authority_decision_options: WAIVE_READINESS_GAP: Authority waives unmet condition; convert HOLD to PROCEED
REQUEST_IMPROVEMENT: Require improvement of readiness gap; trigger re-evaluation of Phase 16-3 or Phase 15-7/15-8 design
HOLD_PENDING_OTHER_PHASE: Hold measurement pending another phase completion (e.g., Phase 15-7 result needed before Phase 15-8 proceeds)
ESCALATE_TO_DESIGN_PHASE: Readiness gaps indicate fundamental design insufficiency; redesign Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8 before proceeding

procedure_3_authority_decision_recording.action: Record authority decision with timestamp and signature

record_elements.conditions: If WAIVE, any conditions on the waiver (e.g., 'proceed but monitor X')

procedure_4_conditional_proceed_vs_impro.if_authority_waives: Convert judgment result from HOLD to PROCEED; lock judgment result per Phase 17-4 procedures; authorize measurement execution
procedure_4_conditional_proceed_vs_impro.if_authority_requests_improvement: Return to Phase 16-3 (if feasibility assessment needs improvement) or Phase 15-7/15-8 (if measurement design needs revision); upon completion, re-evaluate Phase 17-2 or Phase 17-3

hold_record_elements.hold_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when HOLD decision was issued
hold_record_elements.hold_reason: Narrative explanation of why HOLD was necessary
hold_record_elements.readiness_gaps: List of unmet conditions or caution flags preventing PROCEED
hold_record_elements.readiness_gap_report: Detailed analysis of each gap and recommended improvements
hold_record_elements.decision_conditions: If WAIVE, any conditions attached to waiver
hold_record_elements.next_action: What happens next based on authority decision (measurement proceeds, design improvement triggered, etc.)

proceed_handling_framework.proceed_decision_finality: PROCEED decision is final; measurement workflow can execute immediately upon authorization signature

procedure_1_judgment_result_locking.action: Lock judgment result immediately per Phase 17-4 evidence lock procedures
procedure_1_judgment_result_locking.output: Locked judgment result with hash, timestamp, audit trail

procedure_2_authorization_signature.action: Authority reviews locked judgment result and applies digital signature

signature_elements.signature_scope: This signature authorizes Phase 15-7 (and/or Phase 15-8) measurement execution

procedure_3_measurement_execution_author.action: Issue measurement execution authorization to Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8

authorization_content.judgment_result_locked_reference: Reference to locked judgment result from Phase 17-4
authorization_content.execution_scope: Measurement workflow can now proceed to actual integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission measurements

proceed_record_elements.proceed_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when PROCEED decision was issued
proceed_record_elements.proceed_phase: Phase 17-2 or Phase 17-3 (or BOTH if both PROCEED)
proceed_record_elements.proceed_reason: All gates passed; measurement execution authorized
proceed_record_elements.locked_judgment_result_reference: Link to locked judgment result record from Phase 17-4
proceed_record_elements.measurement_execution_authorization_issu: Timestamp when measurement authorization was issued to Phase 15-7 and/or Phase 15-8

combined_judgment_result_decision_matrix.matrix_purpose: Quick reference for handling all 8 combination scenarios (Phase 17-2 × Phase 17-3 outcomes)

matrix_cells.handling: Lock both; authorize both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 execution
Lock Phase 17-2; escalate Phase 17-3 to authority; Phase 15-7 proceeds; Phase 15-8 suspended
Lock Phase 17-2; Phase 15-7 proceeds; Phase 15-8 blocked; analyze Phase 15-8 blocking gate failure
Lock Phase 17-3; escalate Phase 17-2 to authority; Phase 15-8 proceeds; Phase 15-7 suspended
Escalate both to authority; both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 suspended; authority decides independently
Escalate Phase 17-2 to authority; Phase 15-8 blocked; analyze Phase 15-8 blocking gate failure; separate decision workflows
Lock Phase 17-3; Phase 15-7 blocked; Phase 15-8 proceeds; analyze Phase 15-7 blocking gate failure
Both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 blocked; analyze both blocking gate failures; escalate for comprehensive remediation
Phase 15-7 blocked; Phase 15-8 suspended; analyze Phase 15-7 blocking gate failure; escalate Phase 15-8 independently

judgment_result_difference_analysis_trig.trigger_1_phase16_change: Phase 16 artifacts modified after Phase 17-1 completion → Trigger Phase 17-1 re-execution → Conditionally trigger Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 difference analysis
judgment_result_difference_analysis_trig.trigger_2_phase17_1_downgrade: Phase 17-1 receipt status changes from CONFIRMED to FAILED → Trigger Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 difference analysis (gate 1 becomes FAIL)
judgment_result_difference_analysis_trig.trigger_3_gate_input_change: Gate input data changes (Phase 16-3 output, authority decision, state values) → Trigger affected gate re-evaluation and overall result difference analysis
judgment_result_difference_analysis_trig.trigger_4_time_based_revalidation: Lock timestamp becomes stale (e.g., > 24 hours old) → Request authority decision to refresh or re-evaluate
judgment_result_difference_analysis_trig.trigger_5_security_incident: Tampering detected in Phase 17-4 evidence lock → Trigger forensic investigation and comprehensive re-evaluation

depends_on: Phase 17-2: Phase 15-7 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment report (provides PROCEED/HOLD/HALT result)
Phase 17-3: Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment report (provides PROCEED/HOLD/HALT result)
Phase 17-4: Judgment result evidence lock and tamper detection rules (provides locking procedures)
feeds_into: Phase 17-6: Measurement workflow execution preconditions and final halt conditions (uses decision handling rules)
Phase 15-7: integrated_decision measurement workflow (receives authorization or halt decision)
Phase 15-8: receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow (receives authorization or halt decision)

design_review_checklist: PROCEED handling procedure: locking → authority signature → measurement authorization
HOLD handling procedure: readiness gap analysis → authority decision → conditional proceed or return
HALT handling procedure: forensic analysis → remediation planning → authority approval → re-evaluation
Return routing rules clear (what returns where based on trigger)
Authority decision options enumerated for each scenario
Combined decision matrix (9 cells) complete and consistent
HOLD record and HALT record structures defined
Trigger conditions for difference analysis specified
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: PROCEED/HOLD/HALT judgment handling rules approved AND authority decision flows finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 17 design authority + Authority decision stakeholder
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 17-6 (measurement workflow execution preconditions and final halt conditions) can begin once judgment result handling rules are approved
